The Rust + CHERI Working Group explores how Rust and CHERI can work together to strengthen software security. By combining Rust’s memory-safety guarantees with CHERI’s hardware-enforced memory protection and compartmentalisation capabilities, the group helps advance practical approaches to building more resilient systems. The Rust software ecosystem page explains the relationships between Rust and CHERI.
